KEN.note: Document concerns a county health system, not central government finance, tax or payroll.

facts.fact: Murang'a County's court papers say its access to the Afya.KE system, used across its more than 176 health facilities to record patient details, prescriptions and laboratory requests, was withdrawn on 14 October 2026 without a workable transition.

systems.owner: Murang'a County Government (Ministry of Health says it is a private arrangement with the developers)

KEN.note: Claims submission to SHA is mentioned only in the county's account of a system now cut off; no exchange in service is stated.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health has set 30 October 2026, in a published notice, as the deadline for health providers to move to the national government's Health Management Information System.

KEN.note: States a county health application, not an office connection.
No tax filing or payment stated.
